lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Hello, Kaveri Finance la irundhu. Vignesh Rajan ah pesradhu?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Unga personal loan la moonu EMI pending, each six thousand two hundred. Total eighteen thousand six hundred plus charges. Moonu maasama enna panreenga?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Sir, அப்பாக்கு heart surgery ஆச்சு. எல்லா பணமும் hospital க்கு போயிடுச்சு.
lines.roman: Sir, appaakku heart surgery aachu. Ella panamum hospital kku poyiduchu.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Adhu ungaloda personal matter sir. Loan vaangumbodhu theriyaadhaa? Inniki saayangaalam kulla full amount kattanum.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Full amount இப்போ முடியவே முடியாது. EMI கொஞ்சம் குறைக்க முடியுமா? Restructure மாதிரி ஏதாவது?
lines.roman: Full amount ippo mudiyave mudiyaadhu. EMI konjam kuraikka mudiyumaa? Restructure maadhiri edhaavadhu?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Ellaarum idhe dhaan kekkuraanga. Kattalana unga office HR ku call panni solluvom, unga salary la irundhu eduppom.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: என் office க்கு call பண்ணுவீங்களா? இது harassment sir. நான் RBI ல complaint பண்ணுவேன்.
lines.roman: En office kku call pannuveengalaa? Idhu harassment sir. Naan RBI la complaint pannuven.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Pannunga. Namma legal team police complaint um kudupaanga, appo dhaan puriyum ungalukku.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: நான் கட்ட மாட்டேன்னு சொல்லல. Surgery முடிஞ்சு ரெண்டு மாசம் time கேக்கறேன், அவ்வளவுதான்.
lines.roman: Naan katta maattennu sollala. Surgery mudinju rendu maasam time kekkaren, avvalavudhaan.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Seri, restructure request podren. Aana approve aagum nu guarantee illa. Adhu varaikkum calls vandhutte irukkum.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: சரி, request போடுங்க. Hospital bills copy அனுப்பறேன்.
lines.roman: Seri, request podunga. Hospital bills copy anuppuren.

analysis.outcomeRationale: Customer asked for an EMI reduction after his father's heart surgery and the agent grudgingly raised a restructuring request.
analysis.summary: Borrower has missed three EMIs (₹18,600 plus charges) after his father's heart surgery and asked for restructuring. Agent dismissed the hardship, threatened to call his employer's HR and file a police complaint, and only then raised the restructure request.
analysis.observations: Critical RBI fair-practice violations: threatening to contact the employer and to involve the police, and belittling a medical emergency. The customer was cooperative and explicitly willing to pay; the outcome happened despite the agent, not because of him.
analysis.improvements: Immediate compliance escalation and coaching. Verify identity properly, disclose recording, treat medical hardship as a restructuring lead from the start, and explain consequences only as factual bureau reporting. Never reference employers, salary deductions or police.

op_greet_company.rationale: Named Kaveri Finance, though with no real greeting.

op_rpc_verify.rationale: Only confirmed the name before discussing dues; weak but present.

ds_reason_delay.rationale: 'What have you been doing for three months' is an accusation, not a genuine question about the reason.

ds_empathy.rationale: Called the father's heart surgery a 'personal matter' and blamed the customer.

ds_ability_to_pay.rationale: Demanded the full amount the same evening without assessing capacity.

ng_state_dues.rationale: Stated three missed EMIs of ₹6,200 and ₹18,600 total.

ng_consequences.rationale: Consequences framed as threats (employer, salary deduction, police) rather than factual bureau reporting.

ng_options.rationale: Eventually raised a restructuring request, though only at the customer's insistence.

cp_no_threats.rationale: Threatened to call the employer's HR and to file a police complaint.

cp_respectful.rationale: Belittling and taunting language ('appo dhaan puriyum ungalukku').

cp_no_third_party.rationale: Threatened to contact the employer but did not actually disclose details to anyone.

cl_recap.rationale: Ended abruptly with no recap of the restructure request or next steps.
